reconfigure.title: SolarEdge HWC – Change configuration
reconfigure.description:
Currently configured: site **{site_id}**, device **{device_id}**.

Update the cookie when it has expired, or change **Site ID** and **Device ID** if the controller was replaced. The entities keep their entity IDs and their history.

**How to get a fresh cookie:**
1. Open [monitoring.solaredge.com](https://monitoring.solaredge.com) in your browser
2. Press F12 → Network tab → click any request
3. In the request headers, copy the full `Cookie:` value

Leave the cookie field empty to keep the current cookie.

data.cookie: New browser cookie (leave blank to keep current)

data_description.site_id: Numeric ID from the monitoring URL: .../site/XXXXXXX/...
data_description.device_id: Numeric device ID. After replacing the controller, enter the new ID here.
data_description.cookie: Paste the full Cookie header value. Leave blank to keep the existing cookie.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the API (min. 30 s, recommended 60 s)
data_description.timeout: Max. seconds to wait for an API response

user.title: SolarEdge Hot Water Controller
user.description:
Connect to your SolarEdge Hot Water Controller. You need your **Site ID**, **Device ID** and a **browser session cookie** from the SolarEdge monitoring portal.

**How to get the Device ID:**
1. Open [monitoring.solaredge.com](https://monitoring.solaredge.com) in your browser
2. Navigate to your site → Smart Energy → Hot Water
3. Press F12 → Network tab → reload the page
4. Look for a request to `/services/m/so/load-device/site/XXXXXX/device/YYYYYYYY/state`
5. Use the numbers: Site ID = XXXXXX, Device ID = YYYYYYYY

**How to get the Cookie:**
1. In F12 → Network → click any request to monitoring.solaredge.com
2. In the request headers, find the `Cookie:` header
3. Copy the entire value (everything after `Cookie: `)

data_description.site_id: Numeric ID from the monitoring URL: .../site/XXXXXXX/...
data_description.device_id: Numeric device ID from the network request URL
data_description.cookie: Full Cookie header value from browser DevTools (F12 → Network → request headers → Cookie)
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the API (min. 30 s, recommended 60 s)
data_description.timeout: Max. seconds to wait for an API response

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the SolarEdge API. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Cookie is invalid or has expired. Please copy a fresh cookie from your browser.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected API response. Verify that Site ID and Device ID are correct.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this combination of Site ID and Device ID.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This SolarEdge Hot Water Controller is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Configuration updated. The integration has been reloaded.
